subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): keep blank credentials from overriding AWS auth

question: Should default-chain Amazon Bedrock requests be allowed to remove whitespace-only AWS credential environment variables from the shared gateway process in order to restore AWS SDK fallback credentials?
rationale: The patch is technically focused and has real SDK proof, but the remaining compatibility tradeoff is a permanent process-global mutation that code review cannot classify as acceptable without owner intent.

options.title: Approve scoped cleanup
options.body: Accept deletion of invalid whitespace-only AWS credential variables on default-chain Bedrock paths because those values cannot represent usable AWS credentials and the change restores normal SDK fallback behavior.

options.title: Require a non-global resolution seam
options.body: Keep the bug fix open until Bedrock can bypass blank values without mutating shared `process.env`, if such a supported AWS SDK boundary is feasible.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept deletion of invalid whitespace-only AWS credential variables on default-chain Bedrock paths because those values cannot represent usable AWS credentials and the change restores normal SDK fallback behavior.
